title: Client holiday gifts: only $25 per person is deductible
label: Tax myth vs fact

lines: Leah sends 10 clients a $100 gift basket.

items.t: Keep a list: who, what, cost

cta.sub: We'll DM you our Is It Deductible? tool.

captions.instagram:
Sending clients holiday gifts? The deduction is smaller than most people think.

✔️ The IRS lets you deduct no more than $25 for business gifts to each person during the year.
✔️ Example: 10 clients, a $100 basket each. You spent $1,000; the deduction is $250.
✔️ Keep a list of who got what and what it cost, and save the receipts.
✔️ Record them as gifts, not as supplies or marketing.

Send gifts because they're good for the relationship. Check other expenses with our Is It Deductible? tool.

sources.fact: You can deduct no more than $25 for business gifts to each person during your tax year; generally only 50% of business meal expenses unless an exception applies; employer recreational, social or similar activities (e.g., holiday parties, summer picnics) are excepted from the 50% limit (Pub 463, 2025); read 2026-10-30
